reviews.title: Fanxiang ssd worth the money
reviews.comment: Fanxiang... For me first time I hear this name for a nvme SSD m.2 pCle. At first I was sketchy about buying it but now I kind of like it. It's affordable drive quality is at its point the functionality works very proper. Size is not that big format compatibility is absolutely great instructions to assemble it very easy. It's very compatibility on any PC laptop or in casement it works perfectly fine! From now on I'm going to order more with Fanxiang. They also have different sizes and capacities.
reviews.author: Hiro

reviews.title: Using it externally works pretty well.
reviews.comment: Currently using this with an external 3.1 usb enclosure to dual boot my windows laptop with Debian 13. No lag, works well.
reviews.author: Mississippi Justin

reviews.title: Plug and play
reviews.comment: Absolutely plug and play ! I needed extra storage for projects and this was a decent product choice for the price. I also bought a m.2 USB enclosure and it's compatible with it. I have yet to stress test it to get a baseline on its speed since its not actually in an m.2 slot but so far its doing its job ! came with everything you needed and I believe it had a mini heat sink on. I opened up my temp checking app and it was running pretty cool so no complaints on that. I would absolutely buy this again for other projects.
reviews.author: CheesyFries

reviews.title: Fast and powerful
reviews.comment: I didn't test the speed but it was bought for a family member. I installed it on a desktop pc with Windows 11 Pro, and it seemed to be very fast without glitches. It's being used every day for 10+ hours a day and seems to be well made. It had the word pro in it and was 256 GB, so it was the best for the price of this size. I have bought this similar type before at 128 gb and that was good but it had low memory but at least that was used for watching videos and casual every day task.
reviews.author: David Lee

reviews.title: Great Value and Speed
reviews.comment: 3 months in, I couldn't be happier with the performance on this drive - the OEM SSD in my laptop failed and this was a more than suitable replacement. This drive is extremely fast, well-packaged and easy to install.
